mapper.select: SELECT mst.office_seq, mst.cost_seq, mst.cost_category_code, mst.krw_amount, mst.discount_ratio, mst.cost_remittance_count, COALESCE(vtdp."costRemittanceDate", mst.cost_remittance_date) AS cost_remittance_date, COALESCE(vtdp."requestDate", mst.cost_date) AS cost_date, mst.cost_remittance_yn, mst.cost_fee, mst.remittance_count, mst.payment_div, mst.app_no, mapp.mapping_cost_seq, mapp.tbl_seq, mst.create_user, mst.create_at, mst.update_user, mst.update_at, mst.note, mst.del_yn FROM utb_cost_mst mst INNER JOIN utb_cost_mapp mapp ON mst.mapping_cost_seq = mapp.mapping_cost_seq LEFT JOIN v_total_duedate_pivot vtdp ON mst.cost_seq = vtdp.tbl_seq WHERE mapp.tbl_seq = #{tblSeq} AND mapp.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND mst.del_yn = 'N' AND mapp.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY mst.create_at DESC
